content: From CD PROJEKT RED and TRIGGER. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Ready to be burned again? Brace yourself for October 20, as a new cast of characters are unleashed on Night City. Follow Roman, Talia, D, King, and more as they discover the raw, brutal nature of life on the edge in the City of Dreams. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 airs exclusively on Netflix.
